title: ua-parser-js 0.7.29, 0.8.0 and 1.0.0
summary: An attacker published ua-parser-js 0.7.29, 0.8.0 and 1.0.0 from a hijacked maintainer account, each with a preinstall hook that fetched a credential stealer and a miner, and the advisory followed 8 hours 23 minutes later. Package and advisory timestamps come from the npm registry and the GitHub Advisory Database listed in sources; the eight services, their descriptions and their lockfile resolution times are invented demo fixtures and name no real victim.

advisories.summary: Embedded malicious code in ua-parser-js: 0.7.29, 0.8.0 and 1.0.0 ran a script that installed a password stealer and a cryptominer. Tracked as CVE-2021-4229.
